# Paul Irving & Twin Sailors

- [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) — Friend of — [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md) — imaginary rock people friends who come ashore to talk to him · since v2  <sub>[v2 XI Facts and Fancies P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) writes a letter to [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) sharing humorous anecdotes about her pupils and the compositions they submitted. She details how she confronted [Annetta Bell](../character/annetta-bell.md) for copying old love letters for her assignment and highlights [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) Irving's imaginative letter describing his rock friends.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies

> [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) writes to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about his imaginative friends at the shore, including [Nora](../character/nora.md), the [Twin Sailors](../character/twin-sailors.md), and the [Golden Lady](../character/golden-lady.md). He describes fantastical adventures, such as sailing into a moonglade and visiting the sunset, before clarifying in a postscript that the letter is not real.
>
> — v2 · XI Facts and Fancies
